names.en: Hundred and Eighty Slaves true inheritance
aliases: Hundred and Eighty Slaves' true inheritance Hundred and Eighty Slaves' inheritance

summary.text: Hundred and Eighty Slaves true inheritance is the enslavement path legacy of the Eastern Sea Gu Immortal Hundred and Eighty Slaves. Eastern Sea Zombie Alliance grasped it and put a portion of its contents on sale to members.

claims.text: He had a rough childhood and was born a slave. He used every opportunity and took risks until he climbed to the peak of his life, an absolute genius of enslavement path in his generation. Normal enslavement path methods use higher status to rule lower status; he did the opposite, using beasts of lower status to rule those of higher status. Shark Demon once purchased a portion of Hundred and Eighty Slaves’ true inheritance content, wanting to use groups of sharks to gain control over that one finger flow shark.
